card.name: Separators inside condition lists
card.fires_on: Commas, "or", and opening parentheses that follow a condition name in a list, such as asthma, strabismus or respiratory tract. It also fires at some partway points in numbers or words.

modes.label: List separator after condition
modes.description: A comma or "or" right after a disease name, where another condition is about to be listed.
modes.example: History of asthma<<,>> urticaria, or other allergic-type

modes.label: Bracket or "including" before examples
modes.description: A parenthesis or "including" that introduces examples of a condition or event.
modes.example: arterial thromboembolic events (<<including>> transient ischemic attack, cerebrovascular

modes.label: Partway through a word or number
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a word or number inside a dose or reaction list.
modes.example: 12.5 Units to <<5>>0 Units in 1 site Flexor

card.writes: It suppresses "radi-" and "progress-" continuations, so it lowers odds of those words coming next.
card.plain: It marks the spot after a disease name where a list continues, such as asthma, then a comma.
